🔨 DIY Rule of Thumb: Never order flooring by exact room square footage.

Always add:
• 10% for Straight Plank
• 15% for Diagonal
• 20% for Herringbone

Calculate your exact box count & waste margin in seconds:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/flooring/flooring-calculator

#DIY #Flooring #HomeImprovement #CraftCalc

🎨 Contractor Secret: 1 standard interior door = 21 sq ft. 1 standard window = 15 sq ft.

Deducting these before buying paint saves you at least 1-2 wasted gallons ($80+) per room!

Get exact paint gallon math here:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/painting/paint-calculator

#PaintingHacks #HomeRenovation #CraftCalc

🏗️ How many 80lb bags of concrete for a 10×10 patio slab (4" thick)?

Answer: Exactly 56 bags (or 1.23 cubic yards).

Never guess structural concrete yardage. Free contractor estimator:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/concrete-masonry/concrete-slab-calculator

#Concrete #ContractorLife #DIYProject

📐 What trowel notch size do you REALLY need for 12"×24" porcelain floor tiles?

Answer: 1/2" × 1/2" square-notch + back-buttering.

Calculate exact tile cartons, grout bags, and mortar requirements:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/flooring/tile-calculator

#Tiling #BathroomRemodel #DIYTools

🌿 Landscape Pro Formula:
Area (sq ft) × Target Depth (inches) ÷ 324 = Exact Cubic Yards of Mulch or Gravel.

For a 200 sq ft garden bed at 3" depth = 1.85 cubic yards (25 bags).

Free Mulch & Gravel Calculator:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/garden/mulch-calculator

#Landscaping #GardenDIY #CraftCalc

📦 Buying Vinyl Plank (LVP)? Always check carton square footage.

Most boxes cover 19 to 24 sq ft. If you have 350 sq ft + 10% waste (385 sq ft) / 20 sq ft = 20 Full Boxes!

Calculate LVP packs and underlayment in 10s:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/flooring/vinyl-flooring-calculator

#LVP #FlooringCalculator #HomeImprovement

🧱 How many standard 8×8×16 cinder blocks (CMU) do you need for a 50 ft retaining wall (4 ft tall)?

Total wall area: 200 sq ft.
Total blocks: Exactly 225 CMU blocks + 7 bags of Type S mortar!

Calculate masonry blocks and mortar bags:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/concrete-masonry/block-calculator

#Masonry #RetainingWall #BuildingTools

🖌️ Do you need 1 coat or 2 coats of paint?

• Same color / Refresh: 1 coat
• Drastic color shift: 1 Primer + 2 Coats
• Brand new drywall: 1 PVA Primer + 2 Coats

Calculate your exact gallons and primer needs:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/painting/wall-paint-calculator

#PaintingTips #HousePainting #CraftCalc

📏 How to measure an L-shaped room for flooring or carpet?

Split the L into two clean rectangles (Section A + Section B), calculate each area, then sum them up!

Free smart Room Area & Perimeter Calculator:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/rooms/room-area-calculator

#DIYMath #RoomArea #Carpentry

⚠️ The #1 Laminate Flooring Mistake: Forgetting the 3/8" perimeter expansion gap!

Laminate planks expand and contract with humidity. If installed tight to the drywall, they will buckle.

Plan your laminate layout and foam rolls:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/flooring/laminate-calculator

#LaminateFlooring #WoodFloors #DIYHacks

🌱 How many pallets of sod/turf do you need for a new lawn?

1 standard sod pallet = 450 to 500 square feet (approx 50 rolls).
For a 2,500 sq ft lawn, you need exactly 5.5 → 6 Pallets!

Free Turf & Sod Calculator:
👉 https://tool-1-pied.vercel.app/calculators/garden/turf-calculator

#LawnCare #LawnCareTips #Turf

📐 Metric vs Imperial Construction Cheat Sheet:

• 1 Meter = 3.281 Feet (3' 3-3/8")
• 1 Sq Meter = 10.764 Sq Feet
• 1 Cubic Yard = 0.765 Cubic Meters
